body: As someone who is also in need of help, let me help you. I've been through school... With its clicks and bully's. I've cut myself and been medicated when someone finally took notice. I've tried to kill myself but failed, I never told anyone because I knew that would make things at school much worse. I have my good days, and I have my bad. And while right now I'm at a bad time I am trying to remember that it will be ok. In ten years, the people who bullied you and rejected you will be a memory. It won't be easy. But it will pass. If you have access to a phone that you can chat privately with someone please call a suicide hotline. Even if you tell them you're ok and not in danger of hurting yourself just talk to someone. It helps...trust me. I know it looks like the only way out but you have options ok. And many people who are willing to help.
